data.comment:
# Comfy HeyGen Video 1.0- Text to Video

Generate a 5-15 second clip with synchronized dialogue and sound from a text prompt using HeyGen Video 1.0, at 480p or 768p in any of six aspect ratios, with no input files required. One video is output. Ideal for UGC-style talking clips, product explainers, and short social ads where the spoken line and the ambience have to match the scene.
 Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_heygen_video_1_t2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt: A woman in her late twenties in a cream knit sweater sits at a sunlit kitchen counter and holds up a small glass jar of honey to the camera, smiling. She speaks directly to the camera: "This is the only honey I buy now. One spoon and you can actually taste the orange blossom." Natural room tone with a faint kettle whistle in the background, then a soft glass clink as she sets the jar down on the countertop. Handheld medium shot, warm afternoon light, shallow depth of field.
